paragraphs: R' Yehudah bar Mansia. See the entry R' Yehudah bar Menashya.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has מנסיא with samekh, Mansia; the target has מנשיא with shin, Menashya. These are retained rather than changed to Menasheh or marked as an established source error. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
